dataRoles.name: measure
dataRoles.description: The measure whose distribution is drawn, evaluated per Detail row.

dataRoles.name: category
dataRoles.description: The ID of each observation: order, employee, ticket. Without it there is no distribution.

dataRoles.name: tooltips
dataRoles.description: Extra values in the tooltip, shown as the average per bar.

dataRoles.name: panel
dataRoles.description: One histogram per value of this field: region, product, channel. They share an axis.

template.description: Report theme, the default, follows the theme of the report. Classic is the look of earlier versions. The others are Pro.

show.description: A bar with two handles under the axis to filter the report by a range of values.

shortcuts.description: Quartiles, no outliers and top 10% in one click, and what the range holds. Pro.

color.description: Color of the range and its handles.

inColor.description: Color of the bars inside the range. Pro.

outColor.description: Color of the bars outside the range. Empty: dimmed. Pro.

bins.description: Number of bins. Free tier is fixed at 10. Upgrade to Pro for 2–100.

trimLower.description: Trim bottom N% of values as outliers. Pro only.

trimUpper.description: Trim top N% of values as outliers. Pro only.

barColor.description: Fill color of the bars. Supports conditional formatting (fx): each bin takes the color the rule gives its middle row.

showIQR.description: Shade the interquartile range (Q1–Q3) behind the bars.

showNormal.description: Overlay a normal distribution curve. Pro only.

showStats.description: Show n, mean, median, σ, min, max panel. Pro only.

showCumulative.description: A line from 0% to 100% on its own right axis: the share of rows up to each bin.

show.description: Show a legend for all active reference lines.

bottom.description: Off = top of chart, On = bottom of chart.

mode.description: Apply International Business Communication Standards colors and styling.

show.description: Show a vertical reference line at a user-defined value.

value.description: Position of the benchmark line on the X axis.

colorBars.description: Bins at or above the benchmark take one color, bins below it another.

show.description: Shade three bands of the value axis and label each with its share of rows and of the total value.

labelColor.description: Empty: the zone color, or black or white when that cannot be read.
